lore: 灾难中的重建经验让中央庭明白，关键工程不能把全部余地都留给一条供给线。锚定设施开始保存可替换构件和应急调度预算，在常规物流中断时，让已经投入的工作仍有条件继续。
application: 把规则锚定试验场升级为冗余规则锚定站，保留原防护、监听和公共方法用途。将当地一份已实付的大型工程备料预存为备件，按需启用360日应急支援：当地建筑建造速度修正+25%，并为已付款的营建阶段提供备用物流。核心营建场和本国安全控制仍必需，新阶段投入保留原条件。

building.name: 冗余规则锚定站
building.requires: F04 research plus completed country F02 identification
preserves: original E08 paid protection, original window/owner/research
building.stacking: parent cannot be rebuilt while child exists/in queue; legacy both active use only child defense

stock.guard: active safe own upgraded station, F04/E09 research, F02 record and real ready B14 stock; nation no other spares even paused
stock.conversion: consume source once then mark spares; releases B14 stock slot, no copy/reversal/refund
stock.discard: original owner may discard even after facility/control/research loss; no refund/other state removal

support.cost: one stored spare pack, no new resource fee
support.limit: one support window across owned colonies, including paused windows
support.requires: original stock owner, safe active upgraded station and F04/E09 research/F02 record; original logistics not required after reserve
support.engineering_work: artifact_civil_supply_segmented_work_site accepts original site OR active local support plus active core large engineering yard
support.affected: already-paid E09 preparing/assembling/commissioning monthly work only
unchanged: new start / next-stage payment still require original logistics
waiting stages do not auto-charge or advance
support.invalid: occupation/bombardment/station/research/archive loss pauses source; 360-day clock continues; restore remaining time
support.expiry: logistics absent -> existing paid work pauses and preserves exact progress; no catch-up/refresh

lifecycle.transfer_or_ownerless_or_destroy: existing ACS clear removes local spares and support, no refund; country knowledge/story preserved
lifecycle.canceled_stock: does not cancel active support or clear other inventory/project

performance.scans: stock/window uniqueness checks owned colonies on player request; monthly work reuses existing ACS iteration

sources.constraint: 中央庭重建/资源协调及普通工业支撑为设定约束；备件、备用物流和数值为Mod设计，不量产神器，不解释异常终极本质。

native_reference.reference: 本机4.5.2及既有建筑升级/triggered_planet_modifier：planet_building_build_speed_mult、planet_orbital_bombardment_damage；B14固定面额/ACS拥有者与原E09月度
native_reference.repair: uses normal native building queues; no repair_building or instant ruin restoration
native_reference.scope: planet stock/window; derived colony build speed; existing monthly work site

limitations: 仅验证结构和项目内显式引用，不验证原版触发器、效果、作用域、数值平衡或事件可达性。
未校验引擎隐式岗位、修正、trait、outliner 图标；须以最新冷启动日志和游戏内显示验收。
未运行游戏；静态 pass 不能变更 runtime_status，也不能代替存档及日志证据。

validation.fixture_note: F02完成档案作为既有输入，执行正式B14支付/库存消费、F04决议和原E09月度。严格作用域栈，未知语法报错。
limitations: 原生升级/队列、实际建筑速度/维修、费用显示与真实存读档未验。
43项为源码检查，不把余额/计时夹具当原生运行证据。

runtime.priority: 阶段试玩仍优先D12，F04抽取一次真实断供续工及锚定升级继承，共用关键读档；不逐包重测。
